rationale: The observed transfers document post-assembly custody but provide no evidence ordering textual revisions. They therefore cannot settle the complete revision order. The mapping supplies no unresolved empirical relation that would license that inference.

signal_basis.exact_text: No entry describes internal leaf position, revision, attachment or binding, and all entries postdate assembly.
No opening, alteration or assembly event is observed during this interval.
The histories differ only in pre-accession internal order, not later handling.
